name: Web Search
description: Search the web and cite sources before answering.
abilities: Searches the web when a question needs current or checkable facts
Cites the pages it used, linked in the answer
Reads past the first results when a question needs it
permissions: Sends the words of each search to Dyadic's search provider

changes.notes: Now a plugin in the Store, on for everyone. Turn it off here when you don't want it.
